ratings_why.fun: One verb in three arenas gives real stacking (Marshal into Grit Pit Elder into Elder of the Centre, Cantor doubling all of it) and deliberate losing (Konrad, Edge-Strutter buying the winner), so the champion grows in ways you plan.
ratings_why.distinct: Duelling the shop, empty slots counting as survivors and a hired champion from another tribe play unlike today's tribes, though stat-stealing and a tall carry are familiar at the core.

verdict_why: Elder of the Centre loops with its own champion gain as written; fix that wording and it is ready to settle.

points.text: Elder of the Centre: the champion is 'another friendly unit', so its own gain triggers Elder again, forever. Say 'another friendly unit other than your champion'.
Cantor's text 'Duels your units start happen twice' is hard to read; try 'Each duel one of your units starts happens twice'.
Edge-Strutter losing on purpose to a shop unit, then buying it with +3/+3, is the tribe's best Johnny trick; a second card that rewards buying a duel winner would make it a line, not a one-off.

Lord of the Old Lek wants empty neighbours while Lek Marshal and Grit Pit Elder want a second unit to duel; that tension is good, and a Tier 2 or 3 piece that rewards a back-row champion in B2 would sharpen the placement puzzle.

Duels against your next opponent's known biggest unit (Dawn Herald, Ottokar) make reading their last board a real decision; consider one card that picks a duel target by slot, so placement on the zigzag matters even more.

standouts.why: Choose to lose a shop duel, then buy the grown winner: a card used outside its obvious job.
Empty slots counting as survivors turns 'few units' into a real board-building choice.
Grit Pit Elder turns every duel source (own board, shop, enemy) into permanent growth, linking all three stories.

weakest.why: Dame Reisig is plain once-a-turn gold with little to combine.
Pennon-Bearer is a single Start of Combat duel with no hook into the rest of the tribe.
Prior repeats Lord of the Old Lek's empty-slot idea without adding a new decision.

flags.note: As written, the champion's gain re-triggers Elder of the Centre with no end.
Pilgrim with Keeper of the Gizzard Stones and Cantor takes huge shop stats three times a turn; the designer already flags it.
Ottokar with Cantor and Keeper may decide fights at Start of Combat.
